descriptions.preferred: 'Bloodgood' is one of the most popular large-leaved, upright-growing tree forms of red palmatum in the United States and Europe, and has become a standard by which all newer red palmatum cultivars are judged. It is a very good deep red or black red and holds its color into late summer better than most red-leaved forms. It does not bronze out as many other forms do. In extreme hot sun underside is usually a shiny, dark green. Light transmitted through the leaves on a bright day gives a beautiful red effect. Fall colors are usually bright crimson. The dark red petioles are up to 5 cm long. The prominent fruits are a bright red and add to the overall beauty of the plant. This strong-growing cultivar makes an upright tree maturing at up to 10 m or so. Strong branches form a broad-topped tree with a spread about equal to the height. 'Bloodgood' was about the only cultivar being grown from cuttings on a large scale in Dutch nurseries. It is also grafted there. In the United States, thousands of grafts are made onto strong understock, and these make vigorous trees in a short time. It is hoped that this cultivar is kept pure as it has very good qualities not found in some other red-leaved cultivars. Carville (1975) suggested it was a selection from good Nursery, Long Island, New York. Vrugtman (1970) suggested the possibility that this cultivar had its origin in Boskoop, Netherlands, and was propagated by the now discontinued nursery Ebbinge and Groos. It was subsequently exported to the United States where it was Corvallis The origins of this red cultivar are uncertain except, contrary to its name, it did not originate directly from the Netherlands. It is possible it was selected and named at Wright's Nursery in Canby, Oregon, now no longer operating. Its principle claim to recognition among the many red cultivars seems to be that it grows into a dependable, robust, vigorous large tree, with large, deep red leaves which hold their color well throughout the summer. Its ultimate height is 6-8 m. The fiveor seven-lobed leaves are up to 10 cm long and 11 cm wide. The lobes are neatly spread out, with the smaller basal lobes pointing outward or angled slightly backward. Each lobe is broadly ovate with a long tail-like pointed tip, up to 5.5 cm long and 2 cm wide at the broadest point in the middle. It narrows to 1-1.2 cm at the lobe junctions which are about two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. There are numerous sharp fine teeth on the leaf margins. The stout red petioles are 2.5-3.5 cm long. The young leaves emerge a bright pink red color with long, narrow lobes divided at least three-quarters of the way to the leaf base and with conspicuous, coarse teeth. descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Bloodgood' 是美国和欧洲最受欢迎的大叶、直立生长红叶掌状槭树形之一，并已成为衡量所有新红叶掌状槭品种的标准。其叶色为优良的深红或黑红色，比大多数红叶类型更能把颜色保持到夏末。它不像许多其他类型那样会在季中褪成古铜色。在极端炎热和强日照下，叶背通常呈有光泽的深绿色。晴天时光线透过叶片，会呈现出非常美丽的红色效果。秋色通常为鲜亮的深绯红色。深红色叶柄长可达 5 厘米。醒目的果实为鲜红色，提升了植株整体观赏性。该品种生长强健，形成直立乔木，成熟高度约可达 10 米。强壮的枝条形成宽顶树冠，冠幅大致与株高相当。'Bloodgood' 曾几乎是荷兰苗圃中唯一大规模采用扦插繁殖的品种，当地也进行嫁接繁殖。在美国，成千上万株被嫁接到强健砧木上，因此能在较短时间内长成生长旺盛的大树。希望这一品种能够保持纯正，因为它具备一些其他红叶品种所没有的优良特性。Carville（1975）认为它可能选自纽约长岛的 Bloodgood Nursery。Vrugtman（1970）则提出，该品种也有可能起源于荷兰 Boskoop，并由现已停业的 Ebbinge and Groos 苗圃繁殖。后来它被出口到美国。Corvallis。这个红叶品种的起源并不明确，但可以确定的是，与其名称所暗示的不同，它并非直接起源于荷兰。它也可能是在俄勒冈州 Canby 的 Wright's Nursery 选育并命名的，该苗圃现已停业。它之所以能在众多红叶品种中受到认可，主要在于它能长成稳定、健壮、长势旺盛的大型乔木，具大型深红色叶片，并且整个夏季都能较好保持叶色。最终高度为 6–8 米。叶片 5 或 7 裂，长可达 10 厘米、宽 11 厘米。裂片整齐展开，较小的基部裂片向外伸展或略向后斜。每一裂片均为宽卵形，先端具长尾状尖端，长可达 5.5 厘米，在中部最宽处约 2 厘米。裂片连接处宽度缩窄至 1–1.2 厘米，该处分裂深度约达叶基的三分之二。叶缘有许多尖锐细齿。粗壮的红色叶柄长 2.5–3.5 厘米。新叶展开时呈鲜亮的粉红红色，裂片细长，分裂至少达叶基的四分之三，并具明显粗齿。随着叶片发育充实，颜色转为深……
